bar.name: Quick Fingers
bar.text: Mana Steal burns +3 MP from enemies that have a buff.

bar.name: Wide Basin
bar.text: Drain Field gives your team 1 MP for each enemy it hits.

bar.name: Warded Steps
bar.text: Allies under your Spell Ward take 5% less physical damage.

0.f1.name: Wide Channels
0.f1.text: Mana Overflow gives your team +1 MP per rank.

0.f2.name: Soaking Robes
0.f2.text: Magic damage you block counts 4% more per rank toward Mana Overflow.

0.f3.name: Overflow Spill
0.f3.text: Each Mana Overflow trigger gives the ally with the least MP 1 extra MP per rank.

0.n0.name: Tidal Surge
0.n0.text: Every third Mana Overflow trigger gives your team 15 MP instead of 5.

0.r.name: Hunter's Read
0.r.text: Mana Overflow gains 3 blocked damage per rank whenever an enemy gains a buff.

0.ea.name: Conduit
0.ea.text: Mana Overflow pours all its MP into the ally with the least MP instead of spreading it.

0.eb.name: Spillover
0.eb.text: MP an ally would gain above its max goes to the ally with the least MP.

0.ma.name: Brimming Ally
0.ma.text: An ally that Mana Overflow fills to full MP gains Haste for 1 turn.

0.fa.name: Lifeline Pact
0.fa.text: Conduit gives that ally double MP, but Mana Overflow needs 45 blocked damage.

0.fb.name: Martyr's Overflow
0.fb.text: Mana Overflow gives allies 8 MP, but you get none and lose 5% max HP on each trigger.

0.mb.name: Spell Sink
0.mb.text: When Mana Overflow triggers, you Guard the ally with the lowest HP until your next turn, taking 30% of its damage.

0.v.name: Endless Spring
0.v.text: Mana Overflow becomes Endless Spring: magic damage blocked by your allies' magic armor also counts, not only yours.

1.f1.name: Generous Cut
1.f1.text: Mana Steal gives you 10% more of the burned MP per rank.

1.f2.name: Deep Pockets
1.f2.text: Mana Steal burns +2 MP per rank from enemies above half MP.

1.f3.name: Deep Cut
1.f3.text: Mana Steal also burns 3% of the target's max MP per rank.

1.n0.name: Prying Blade
1.n0.text: Mana Steal removes one random buff from its target.

1.r.name: Bare Steel
1.r.text: Mana Steal +5% damage per rank against enemies with no buffs.

1.ea.name: Siphon Vein
1.ea.text: Mana Steal gains 100% of the MP it burns instead of 50%.

1.eb.name: Quickening Steal
1.eb.text: If Mana Steal's target is at 0 MP, the ally with the least MP gains Haste for 1 turn.

1.ma.name: Drink Deep
1.ma.text: Mana Steal also heals you for the MP it burns.

1.fa.name: Drained Dry
1.fa.text: Mana Steal burns 20 MP instead of 10, but deals no damage.

1.fb.name: Hurried Hands
1.fb.text: Mana Steal takes only half a turn, but gains a 2-turn cooldown.

1.mb.name: Tempo Thief
1.mb.text: If Mana Steal empties its target, your next turn comes faster, as after Skip Turn.

1.v.name: Spellsplitter
1.v.text: Mana Steal becomes Spellsplitter: it removes every buff from its target and deals +15% damage per buff removed.

2.f1.name: Wide Siphon
2.f1.text: Drain Field burns +4% of max MP per rank.

2.f2.name: Hushing Mist
2.f2.text: Drain Field Silence chance +4% per rank.

2.f3.name: Long Quiet
2.f3.text: Drain Field's Silence has a 6% chance per rank to last 1 more turn.

2.n0.name: Sure Hush
2.n0.text: Drain Field always Silences enemies that were already at 0 MP before the cast.

2.r.name: Settling Dust
2.r.text: If Drain Field Silences anyone, 10% chance per rank that its cooldown is 1 turn shorter.

2.ea.name: Focused Siphon
2.ea.text: Drain Field burns 25% more MP from the enemy in its centre cell.

2.eb.name: Wider Grasp
2.eb.text: Drain Field covers one more column (3x3 → 3x4).

2.ma.name: Heart of Quiet
2.ma.text: Drain Field's centre enemy is always Silenced for 1 turn if it ends at 0 MP.

2.fa.name: Narrow Siphon
2.fa.text: Drain Field hits only its centre cell, but burns 100% of that enemy's max MP.

2.fb.name: Shallow Net
2.fb.text: Drain Field Silence chance 50% → 80%, but it no longer deals damage.

2.mb.name: Mass Hush
2.mb.text: If Drain Field empties 3 or more enemies, all of them are Silenced, no roll.

2.v.name: Hall of Silence
2.v.text: Drain Field becomes Hall of Silence: the area stays 2 turns, burns 15% max MP each turn and Silences enemies at 0 MP inside.

3.f2.name: Ward Mending
3.f2.text: Spell Ward heals the warded ally for 2% of its max HP per rank when cast.

3.f3.name: Deep Reserve
3.f3.text: Spell Ward's shield takes +6% per rank from your remaining MP.

3.n0.name: Purging Ward
3.n0.text: Spell Ward first removes every debuff from the warded ally.

3.r.name: Shelter Echo
3.r.text: When Spell Ward breaks, the warded ally heals 3% of its max HP per rank.

3.ea.name: Split Ward
3.ea.text: Spell Ward also wards the ally with the least MP at 50% strength.

3.eb.name: Ward Taunt
3.eb.text: When you cast Spell Ward on yourself, you taunt all enemies for 1 turn.

3.ma.name: Second Ward
3.ma.text: When Spell Ward breaks, a 50% ward forms on the ally with the lowest HP.

3.fa.name: Stretched Ward
3.fa.text: Split Ward is full strength, but Spell Ward costs 18 MP.

3.fb.name: Ironbound Oath
3.fb.text: Spell Ward on yourself is 60% larger, but it can no longer target allies.

3.mb.name: Bastion of Null
3.mb.text: While you hold Spell Ward and a taunt, you take 30% less physical damage.

3.v.name: Mirror Ward
3.v.text: Spell Ward becomes Mirror Ward: magic hits it absorbs are thrown back at the attacker for 50% of their damage.

4.u1.name: Crippling Void
4.u1.text: Void Strike Blinds its target for 1 turn.

4.u2.name: Spell Shatter
4.u2.text: Void Strike's target deals 20% less magic damage for 2 turns.

4.u3.name: Void Shackle
4.u3.text: Void Strike Stuns its target if it is at 0 MP.

4.r1.name: Opening for All
4.r1.text: Void Strike makes its target Overextended.

4.r2.name: Shared Spoils
4.r2.text: Allies that hit the Overextended target gain 4 MP.

4.r3.name: Feeding Frenzy
4.r3.text: If an ally kills Void Strike's target before its next turn, your team gains 15 MP.

4.d1.name: Swift Void
4.d1.text: Void Strike takes only half a turn.

4.d2.name: Ready Blades
4.d2.text: After Void Strike, your next Mana Steal throws an extra dagger.

4.d3.name: Overflow Strike
4.d3.text: Casting Void Strike triggers Mana Overflow at once.

4.l1.name: Rallying Break
4.l1.text: If Void Strike's target had a buff, your team gains Haste for 1 turn.

4.l2.name: Turned Boons
4.l2.text: Allies hasted by Rallying Break also gain 4 MP.

4.l3.name: Grand Theft
4.l3.text: Void Strike steals every buff from its target and spreads them across your team.
